correctness.rationale: Forbidden independent four-sets are exactly monochromatic quadruples or one of the removed four-vertex blocks, because each vertex loses at most two cross edges. Thus X_m is the join sk2(Delta_A)*sk2(Delta_B) with the m disjoint T_i stars removed. Faces cannot contain two T_i, yielding a direct sum relative chain complex of shifted links K_{a-2,b-2}; its only relative H5 is free rank m(a-3)(b-3). The LES reduces the claim to surjectivity of a primitive integer relative map. Tetrahedral boundary differences on the opposite shore generate each augmentation lattice and can be localized to a block by avoiding other P_j pairs when a>=5 (or exchanging shores for b>=5). The exceptional 4x4 double defect sends rank-one to primitive diagonal in Z², giving H4=Z. The full 2-skeleton and vanishing homology lead via Hurewicz and homology Whitehead to integral sphere wedges; nested kernels yield split inclusions. Independently checked Euler counts in nine finite (a,b,m) cases and read separate Smith-normal-form/simplicial rank source; these are bounded corroboration only.
